quests.title: Collector of Anemo Sigils

dialogue.t: Welcome. Every treasure here is unique, guaranteed.
Hehe... Yep, there's nothing here that Paimon recognizes, that's for sure.
Haha, what did I tell you! These are all rare items brought back by adventurers from all corners of the world.
Is there anything that catches your eye?

dialogue.sit: I daren't ask about the price!

dialogue.t: No need! I forgot to mention, I operate on a trading basis. Goods for goods — no Mora accepted here.
I've been trying to make something a bit special recently, and I need a lot of <color=#00E1FFFF>Anemo Sigils</color> to decorate it with.
Do you have any <color=#00E1FFFF>Anemo Sigils</color> with you?
Haha, it seems the Anemo Archon approves of your adventures then.
More to the point, any <color=#00E1FFFF>Anemo Sigils</color> you find you can trade in here for items in the shop.
<color=#00E1FFFF>Anemo Sigils</color> appear all over Mondstadt. If you find yourself short, just keep exploring.

dialogue.sit: Are they really just for decoration?

dialogue.t: Absolutely! What could be more beautiful than a gift from the Anemo Archon?
It's actually more complicated than that, but it's easier for people to understand if I just say it's for decoration.
Obviously the reason I need <color=#00E1FFFF>Anemo Sigils</color> is because they have properties that other materials cannot provide.

dialogue.sit: Let me see it when it's finished.
I feel like you're making this sound more mysterious than it actually is.

dialogue.t: Haha, of course! I guarantee you will be quite surprised at the result.
Do come again soon — and bring me lots and lots of <color=#00E1FFFF>Anemo Sigils</color> next time!
Please also visit if you come across any weird and wonderful treasures on your adventures!

quests.description: Paimon has discovered a very unique store…
